label: UKMTO: Critical
description: Strait of Hormuz remains effectively closed to commercial shipping following the Feb 2026 US-Israel-Iran war; IRGC mining, boardings and attacks ongoing, with April 2026 traffic down to 191 vessels (vs ~3,000/month pre-crisis). US blockade of Iranian ports continues and Iran's 'Persian Gulf Strait Authority' still demands prior coordination for transits. Red Sea / Gulf of Aden re-escalated: Houthi ASBM strikes on cargo ship Norderney and container ship MSC Tavvishi reported 8 Jun 2026 in the Gulf of Aden — first confirmed incidents since the September 2025 pause. Most carriers retain Cape of Good Hope routing; IMO monitoring c.20,000 seafarers in-region.
